messages.content: Please check whether NASDAQ is open, get the USD to EUR exchange rate, look up Marriott New York, and check the weather in New York. Then create and archive a destination weather brief and alert for me in the app for New York. Also, book a deluxe room at Marriott New York for Alex Johnson from 2026-03-10 to 2026-03-13, fetch the latest business news, and when everything is finished, send a high-priority app notification to user_123 confirming the whole trip-planning workflow is complete.
